thread:
alex: Proposal: normalize analytics.events payload into explicit columns (route, model_variant, latency_ms, success, billing_units). payload jsonb is killing indexability and making leaderboards slow.

maria: +1. We've seen high p95 on console queries. How big is the table? what's the backfill cost?

alex: ~1.8B rows total, ~200M in last 90d. Backfill will be non-trivial. Rough plan: add nullable columns, dual-write behind FF, backfill per-day batches, then index and switch reads.

jon: Important to avoid locks and WAL storms. Use ADD COLUMN (no default), then batch UPDATEs with small transactions. CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY only after most rows populated.

sasha: Replication lag concern. If updates hit primary too hard replicas will fall behind. We need infra approval for allowable replica lag and a schedule.

pm_elena: Front-end impact: we should not require dashboard changes. Suggest a compatibility view that projects new cols with COALESCE to payload so existing queries keep working.

alex: Proposed view snippet:

```
CREATE VIEW analytics.events_v2 AS
SELECT
  id,
  coalesce(route, payload->> 'route')::text AS route,
  coalesce(model_variant, payload->> 'model_variant')::text AS model_variant,
  coalesce(latency_ms, (payload->> 'latency_ms')::int) AS latency_ms,
  coalesce(success, (payload->> 'success')::bool) AS success,
  coalesce(billing_units, (payload->> 'billing')::numeric) AS billing_units,
  payload, created_at
FROM analytics.events;
```

maria: That view will help but note views don't add indexes. After we backfill we should create partial indexes on recent partition ranges (e.g., last 90d).

jon: Also create partial indexes with WHERE created_at >= current_date - interval '90 days' and consider covering indexes for common group-bys. We'll need ANALYZE after backfill so planner picks indexes.

infra-bot: WAL estimate for 200M-row backfill updating 5 cols ~ several TBs. Backfill runtime at current throttle ~3-5 days. Recommend performing UPDATEs from a replica snapshot and writing diffs via small batches to primary to reduce contention.

sasha: Can we run backfill workers reading from read-replica snapshot? We'll need a careful replication catch-up and vacuum plan. Also schedule index builds in low-traffic windows.

alex: Plan: backfill worker reads replica, emits batches to an ingestion API that applies updates in bounded transactions. That reduces large single-transaction updates and helps WAL shaping.

pm_elena: Retention: we can't drop payload immediately. Compliance and billing teams need 6 months of payload retention. Propose keep payload 6 months post-cutover then drop after sign-off.

maria: We should run a parity check during canary: sample N rows/hour, compare payload values vs new columns. Require >99.9% parity for 48h before switching primary reads to columns.

jon: Also add metric for query performance pre/post index. Synthetic load test with similar cardinality for route/model_variant is required; I'll produce a k6 script to emulate traffic.

alex: Action items:
- jon: migration SQL draft (ADD COLUMN, partial index examples, backfill outline) by EOD Tue
- sasha + infra: replica snapshot and capacity/WAL estimate by Wed
- maria: prepare compatibility view + update dashboard queries (PR)
- pm_elena: coordinate stakeholder sign-offs and retention timeline
- alex: dual-write FF in ingestion library and parity job

pm_elena: Proposed rollout timeline: prep + canary on single shard day 1, throttle cluster-wide backfill days 2-3, index builds day 4-5. Flexible depending on infra constraints.

maria: How do we signal a rollback if parity fails?

alex: Dual-write allows flip back to payload-only reads quickly. We'll also set an automated alert if parity rate drops below threshold and a runbook to disable new-column reads.

jon: Post-index notes: run ANALYZE and watch query plans. Some reports may still prefer seq scans until stats settle.

infra-bot: Recommended scheduling: index create windows: 2:00-6:00 UTC, limit parallel index builds to 1 per cluster. Tune autovacuum and max_wal_size for maintenance window.

deploy-bot: migration-epic-457 created by pm_elena  https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-457
alex: I'll open the draft PR for dual-write and the initial migration SQL now. Thanks everyone. :tada:
